zh.summary: 比較 TCP Connect、SYN 與 UDP 的探測方式，依回應建立有條件的連接埠觀察。

sourceBody.text: CEH M03-03｜TCP Connect、SYN 與 UDP 掃描
1｜這次要確認的是哪個通訊入口？
連接埠掃描（Port Scanning）像是在確認一棟大樓有哪些窗口受理服務。TCP Connect 完成報到；SYN 先問是否接受報到；UDP 送出申請資料，再觀察回覆。不同問法取得不同證據。
M03-01 說明 IP、TCP、UDP 與 Port；M03-02 探索主機的活動跡象；這一課接著確認指定的 TCP／UDP 入口如何回應。讀完後，請能說明「送出什麼、收到什麼、能下什麼結論」，並完成最後三個情境題。
文中的 192.0.2.20 是文件範例位址；帶有此位址的指令用來解讀選項。實作限定自己的 127.0.0.1，先確認測試連接埠未被其他服務占用；需要停止時按 Ctrl+C，完成後關閉測試程式。
2｜先分清楚：連線、服務與掃描結果
Port（連接埠）是通訊入口的編號。可以把 IP 想成大樓地址，Port 想成窗口號碼：TCP 22 常用於 SSH、TCP 80 常用於 HTTP、TCP 443 常用於 HTTPS、UDP 53 常用於 DNS。這些是慣例；服務可以改用其他編號。TCP 53 與 UDP 53 是分開觀察的入口。
Connection（連線）表示雙方建立了通訊關係。對 HTTPS 而言，TCP 連線成功後，還要經過 TLS 加密協商、HTTP 請求、應用程式處理，才知道網站功能是否正常。
TCP 443 可連線 → TLS 協商 → HTTP 請求 → 應用程式／資料庫
例如 TCP 可以連上，TLS 卻協商失敗；TLS 成功，HTTP 卻回傳 500；首頁正常，登入功能卻故障。每一步只證明該階段的結果。
Listener（監聽端點）表示程式準備在特定 IP、協定與 Port 接收通訊；Service（服務）是實際處理請求的軟體，例如 Nginx、OpenSSH、PostgreSQL。接收連線的也可能是反向代理或負載平衡器，後端另有程式處理。因此 TCP 443 開放還不能確定使用 Nginx，或確認後端健康。
-sT 指 TCP Connect，-p 443 指定連接埠，127.0.0.1 指自己的電腦。假設輸出如下：

PORT     STATE  SERVICE
443/tcp  open   https
443/tcp 是觀察入口；open 是工具判讀；未做服務辨識時，https 通常只是連接埠名稱資料庫的標籤。-sV 會嘗試辨識實際服務與版本，但仍需核對應用層回應。

rows: 實際服務是什麼、是否正常？
TLS、HTTP、服務指紋、應用程式回應

sourceBody.text: 3｜TCP Connect：請作業系統完成連線
TCP 的一般新連線使用三向交握（Three-way Handshake）。SYN（Synchronize）提出連線並同步初始序號；ACK（Acknowledgment）確認收到對方的資訊；RST（Reset）重設連線或連線嘗試。
1. 掃描端送 SYN：「我想建立連線，這是我的同步資訊。」
2. 目標回 SYN＋ACK：「收到你的請求，也提供我的同步資訊。」
3. 掃描端回 ACK：「收到。」一般 TCP 交握完成，連線進入可交換資料的狀態。
TCP Connect Scan 呼叫作業系統的 connect()，由 TCP/IP 網路堆疊處理交握，Nmap 再讀取成功或錯誤結果。掃描通常隨即結束測試連線；連線建立不代表已傳送 HTTP 請求。

rows: 從此位置能建立 TCP 連線
明確拒絕，典型封包是目標回 RST
無法完成連線；不能把所有錯誤都當成 filtered

sourceBody.text: 這種方式通常不需要直接收送原始封包的特殊權限。因為完整建立連線，服務端可能留下連線或立即斷線的紀錄，大量連線也會增加負擔。[Nmap TCP Connect](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-connect-scan.html)

visual.caption: TCP Connect：完成三向交握
visual.description: 透過 connect() 完成 TCP 連線，然後結束測試。

items.title: SYN
items.body: 掃描端 → 目標：提出連線與同步資訊。

items.title: SYN＋ACK
items.body: 目標 → 掃描端：接受請求，提供自己的同步資訊。

items.title: ACK
items.body: 掃描端 → 目標：完成一般交握。

items.title: 判讀提醒
items.body: TCP 連線成功還需另查 TLS、HTTP 與應用功能。

sourceBody.text: 4｜SYN 掃描：從交握起始判讀
SYN Scan 先送 SYN。目標回 SYN＋ACK 時，已表明願意接受建立連線；掃描端以 RST 結束這次嘗試，不送完成一般交握的最後 ACK。因此也稱 Half-open Scan（半開式掃描），描述交握未完成，並非 Port 只開一半。

掃描端 → 目標：SYN
目標 → 掃描端：SYN＋ACK
掃描端 → 目標：RST
判讀 open；未完成一般三向交握

rows: 重試後無回覆，或特定 ICMP 無法到達
此方法無法確認開放或關閉

sourceBody.text: 讀 RST 時要看方向。目標回 RST 是拒絕；掃描端收到 SYN＋ACK 後送 RST 是結束已取得證據的探測。後者也可能由掃描端作業系統產生；實際 RST／ACK 組合依實作而異。
無回覆可能來自去程或回程被擋、封包遺失、設備異常。filtered 本身沒有證明一定存在防火牆。IPv4 SYN 掃描收到 ICMP Type 3、Code 1／2／3／9／10／13 也會判為 filtered。[Nmap SYN](https://nmap.org/book/synscan.html)
sudo nmap -sS -p 443 192.0.2.20
-sS 通常需要原始封包操作權限；實際取決於作業系統、Capabilities 與封包驅動。Nmap 仍透過作業系統介面收送探測，與 -sT 請 connect() 完成交握的分工不同。
Stealth Scan（隱蔽掃描）是歷史名稱。某些只記錄完整連線的應用程式可能留下較少紀錄，但防火牆、IDS（入侵偵測系統）、IPS（入侵防禦系統）仍能觀察連續多 Port 的 SYN 與重設模式。SYN 掃描可被偵測。

visual.caption: SYN Scan：取得起始回應後重設
visual.description: SYN＋ACK 已提供 open 證據；不送最後 ACK。

items.title: SYN
items.body: 掃描端 → 目標：提出連線與同步資訊。

items.title: SYN＋ACK
items.body: 目標 → 掃描端：接受請求，提供自己的同步資訊。

items.title: RST
items.body: 掃描端 → 目標：重設嘗試；未完成一般交握。

items.title: 判讀提醒
items.body: 目標回 RST 才是拒絕；掃描端送 RST 是結束嘗試。

sourceBody.text: 5｜UDP 掃描：以資料報與錯誤回報判讀
UDP 直接傳送 Datagram（資料報），沒有 TCP 三向交握。像寄出一封信：沒收到回信，可能是對方不需回覆、看不懂內容、去程遺失、遭到過濾，或回信途中遺失。
Payload（酬載）是資料報攜帶的內容。DNS 可能回覆格式正確的查詢，卻忽略空白或無效內容；DNS、NTP、SNMP 各有自己的格式。Nmap 對部分常見 UDP Port 使用協定專屬酬載，其他探測未必是服務能理解的請求。

rows: 有端點回應這次資料報
回報 Port Unreachable（連接埠無法到達）
無法區分開放但沉默與受到過濾

sourceBody.text: ICMP 是傳達 IP 錯誤與狀態的控制訊息。UDP 沒有 TCP RST；主機收到送往無接收端點的 UDP 資料報時，典型情況可能回 ICMP Port Unreachable。分析時核對錯誤來源與內含的原始資料報；IPv4 Type／Code 不直接套用到 ICMPv6。
open|filtered 的「|」表示「或」，保留兩種可能，不能當作確定開放，也不能直接斷言服務未啟動。適當的 -sV 服務探測可能取得回覆、將狀態縮小為 open；沒有回覆時仍需設定或日誌等證據。UDP 回覆也只證明該次通訊，未確認所有功能。[Nmap UDP](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-udp-scan.html)

visual.caption: UDP：送出資料報，分別判讀四種回應
visual.description: 掃描端 → 目標：UDP 資料報。四張卡是替代結果，沒有先後順序。

items.title: open
items.body: 收到對應 UDP 回覆；此路徑有端點回應。

items.title: closed
items.body: 收到 IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 3：Port Unreachable。

items.title: filtered
items.body: 收到 IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 1、2、9、10、13。

items.title: open|filtered
items.body: 重試後仍無回覆：可能開放但沉默，也可能受到過濾。

items.title: 判讀提醒
items.body: 核對 ICMP 來源與原始資料報；IPv4 數字不套用 ICMPv6。

sourceBody.text: 6｜為什麼等待時間、速率與位置很重要？
Timeout（逾時）是在指定時間內沒有收到預期回應；Retry（重試）是再送一次探測。假設只等 100 ms，回覆 300 ms 才抵達，就可能過早判定逾時。多次重試會增加時間、封包量與設備負擔，應按環境設定。
掃描 1,000 個 Port，每秒 10 個與每秒 1,000 個的速度不同；過快可能引發限速或丟包，增加等待結果。這些數字只是比較範例。UDP 還受 ICMP Rate Limiting（錯誤回報速率限制）影響：即使多個 Port 都沒有監聽，主機也未必立刻為每次探測送出錯誤，因此 UDP 掃描可能較慢。
sudo nmap -sU -p 53,123,161 --max-rate 10 192.0.2.20
--max-rate 10 限制 Nmap 探測封包的傳送速率上限為每秒 10 個；這不是所有環境的最佳值。實際測試先選少量已核定 Port，依設備承載能力、維護窗口與停止條件調整。
同一台伺服器的 TCP 22，從實驗室內網可能 open，從外網可能 filtered。兩者可以同時成立：來源、路由與防火牆政策不同。但要先確認 NAT、代理或負載平衡器沒有把兩次測試導向不同入口。
NAT（Network Address Translation，網路位址轉換）可能把公開入口轉送到私有 IP，例如 192.168.1.100。外部通常連公開位址；缺少對應 Port Forwarding（連接埠轉送）時，探測可能無法抵達內部主機。內外結果不同未必是服務變了，也不能把所有 NAT 結果都預設為 filtered。
比較報告時一起記錄：來源 IP、目的入口、時間、TCP／UDP、Port、方法、酬載、等待／重試、速率、工具版本與路徑政策。

sourceBody.text: 7｜把三種掃描方法整合起來

rows: 完成一般 TCP 交握
收到對應 UDP 回覆

sourceBody.text: 相同的「無回覆」，SYN 與 UDP 判讀不同，因為 UDP 服務可能正常接收卻保持沉默。記錄結論時寫出方法與觀察，例如：「此來源在此時間對 TCP 443 送 SYN，收到 SYN＋ACK，依 SYN 掃描記為 open；網站功能另行查核。」
8｜在自己的 Ubuntu 上觀察 TCP 與 UDP
環境：Ubuntu、Python 3、Nmap；封包觀察另需 tcpdump 及相應權限。僅使用 127.0.0.1，不需掃描其他設備。先檢查 TCP 8000、8001 與 UDP 9999 是否已被使用；若占用，停止實驗並另選一致的測試埠，不關閉原服務。以下預期結果均為示例，實際狀態受本機政策影響。

ss -ltnu
# 尚未安裝工具時，由你決定是否在實驗機安裝：
sudo apt update
sudo apt install nmap tcpdump
8.1｜TCP：同樣 open，不同交握
Terminal A 在空的實驗資料夾啟動 HTTP Server，避免提供自己的私人檔案：

mkdir -p /tmp/ceh-m0303-http
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /tmp/ceh-m0303-http
Terminal B 執行兩種掃描，假設 TCP 8001 沒有程式監聽：
預期兩次都可能得到 8000/tcp open、8001/tcp closed。SERVICE 名稱依 Nmap 資料庫而定；重點是狀態與封包流程。Terminal C 可先開啟擷取，再重跑掃描：
sudo tcpdump -i lo -nn 'tcp port 8000 or tcp port 8001'
觀察誰送 SYN、誰回 SYN＋ACK，以及 Connect 的最後 ACK 與 SYN Scan 的重設。實際 RST／ACK 組合及結束細節依作業系統與 Nmap 實作而異。完成後在 HTTP Server 與 tcpdump 視窗按 Ctrl+C；空資料夾可用 rmdir /tmp/ceh-m0303-http 移除。
8.2｜UDP：監聽中，也可以不回覆
將以下程式存成 udp_server.py，Terminal A 執行 python3 udp_server.py：

import socket

with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
    sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 9999))
    print("UDP 9999 listening; no replies")
    while True:
        data, addr = sock.recvfrom(4096)
        print(f"Received {len(data)} bytes from {addr}")
        # Add the reply here in the second run.
Terminal B 掃描這個入口：
sudo nmap -sU -p 9999 127.0.0.1
若程式收到資料卻不回覆，預期可能顯示 9999/udp open|filtered。Nmap 只有等待結果；你另有程式監聽及收到資料的本機證據，所以知道此時存在接收端點。
按 Ctrl+C 停止伺服器，在 while 迴圈內的 print 後加入以下一行，保持相同縮排，再重新啟動：
sock.sendto(b"OK", addr)
重跑同一掃描。若 Nmap 收到對應 UDP 回覆，預期變成 open。監聽入口相同，但回覆行為改變了掃描證據。完成後按 Ctrl+C 關閉伺服器；確認程序已停止，再移除自己建立的 udp_server.py。若結果不同，保留程式輸出並核對本機防火牆與權限，不把示例當作保證。
9｜資安實務與三個情境題
在已授權的實驗室，可盤點 NAS 的 TCP 5001／22／445、網站的 TCP 443／80、DNS 的 UDP 53 與 TCP 53。先問各入口用途與預期暴露範圍，再比對內外測試、監聽設定、防火牆政策與日誌；開放可能是業務需要，不等於有漏洞。
M03 掃描找出入口，M04 列舉補充服務資訊，M05 弱點分析評估設定與已知問題，M12 的防護觀念協助驗證偵測與阻擋。驗收時對照核准測試時間的 IDS 告警與實際封包，並保留複測結果。
問題一：SYN Scan 觀察到掃描端送 SYN、目標回 SYN＋ACK、掃描端送 RST。Port 是什麼狀態？最後 RST 是誰送的？三向交握完成了嗎？
問題二：UDP 53 顯示 open|filtered。可以斷言 DNS 未啟動嗎？提出三個可能原因，並說明要補什麼證據。
問題三：NAS 的 TCP 22 從內網看是 open，外網看是 filtered。兩者矛盾嗎？哪些設備或政策會造成差異？要確認 SSH 未對外暴露，還要核對什麼？
10｜把結論連回證據
TCP Connect 依作業系統連線結果判讀；SYN 依起始回應判讀；UDP 綜合資料報回覆、ICMP 與等待結果。沒有回覆需要保留不確定性，尤其 open|filtered。
每筆結果都保留「哪裡、何時、用什麼方法、收到什麼」。下一課 M03-04 再整理 Open、Closed、Filtered 與觀察位置的關係。

[Nmap 掃描方法](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-techniques.html) · [TCP 規範 RFC 9293](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9293) · [UDP 規範 RFC 768](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc768) · [ICMP 規範 RFC 792](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc792)

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：SYN 流程與 RST 方向
paragraphs: 判為 open，依據是目標回覆 SYN＋ACK。最後的 RST 來自掃描端，作用是結束這次嘗試；沒有送出完成一般三向交握的最後 ACK。掃描端作業系統也可能產生這個 RST，不能只憑旗標斷言是目標拒絕。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：UDP 沉默的可能原因
paragraphs: 不能直接判斷 DNS 沒有啟動。可能是服務忽略不合格式的酬載、去程被防火牆丟棄、回覆在回程遺失；ICMP 錯誤限速也可能增加等待結果。保留 open|filtered，補上已授權的有效 DNS 查詢、對應 UDP 回覆、封包擷取，以及監聽設定或服務日誌。服務辨識可能縮小不確定性，沒有回覆仍不能直接確定關閉。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：內外觀察與 SSH 暴露
paragraphs: 兩個結果可以同時成立。來源政策、路由、NAT／連接埠轉送、代理或負載平衡器都可能改變路徑與回應。先確認兩次測試對應同一入口，記錄來源、時間、協定、Port 與方法，再核對公開位址及 IPv4／IPv6 入口、轉送規則、防火牆與 SSH 綁定位址。從核准的外部位置複測並比對日誌；單次 filtered 只支持該來源與時間的觀察，不能證明所有外部路徑都封閉。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：網站功能查核（原有檢核）
paragraphs: 參考答案：補上應用層服務證據；HTTPS 情境也核對 TLS 安全通道與憑證結果，再檢查 HTTP 回應及預定頁面內容。若任務涉及登入或操作權限，再依核准範圍檢查。每一層各記時間、方法與結果。

en.summary: Compare TCP Connect, SYN and UDP probes and interpret their responses as contextual port observations.

sourceBody.text: CEH M03-03 | TCP Connect, SYN and UDP scanning
1 | Which communication endpoint are we checking?

Port scanning resembles checking which service desks in a building accept requests. TCP Connect completes registration; SYN asks whether registration is accepted; UDP sends an application and observes the reply. Each method produces different evidence.

M03-01 introduced IP, TCP, UDP and ports; M03-02 looked for signs of host activity. This lesson asks how a specific TCP or UDP endpoint responds. Aim to explain what was sent, what came back and what conclusion the evidence supports, then answer the three scenarios at the end.

192.0.2.20 is a documentation address; commands containing it illustrate options. Run the practical exercises only against your own 127.0.0.1. Check that the test ports are unused first. Stop with Ctrl+C when necessary and close all test programs afterward.
2 | Separate connections, services and scan results

A port is an endpoint number. Think of the IP address as a building address and the port as a desk number: TCP 22 commonly carries SSH, TCP 80 HTTP, TCP 443 HTTPS and UDP 53 DNS. These are conventions; services can use other numbers. TCP 53 and UDP 53 are separate endpoints.

A connection establishes a communication relationship. For HTTPS, successful TCP establishment precedes TLS encryption negotiation, an HTTP request and application processing. Each stage needs its own evidence.
TCP 443 reachable → TLS negotiation → HTTP request → application/database
TCP might connect while TLS fails; TLS might succeed while HTTP returns 500; the home page might work while login fails. Success at one stage establishes only that stage's result.

A listener is a program ready to receive traffic at a specific IP, protocol and port. A service is software that handles requests, such as Nginx, OpenSSH or PostgreSQL. A reverse proxy or load balancer may accept the connection and forward work to a backend. An open TCP 443 therefore does not identify Nginx or establish backend health.
-sT selects TCP Connect, -p 443 selects the port, and 127.0.0.1 is your own computer. Suppose the output is:

PORT     STATE  SERVICE
443/tcp  open   https

443/tcp identifies the endpoint; open is the tool's interpretation. Without service detection, https is usually a label from the port-name database. -sV attempts to identify the actual service and version, but application responses still require verification.

rows: SYN, SYN/ACK, RST, ICMP, waiting time
How does this method classify it?
open, closed, filtered and other states
What runs here, and does it work?

sourceBody.text: 3 | TCP Connect: ask the operating system to connect

An ordinary new TCP connection uses a three-way handshake. SYN (Synchronize) requests a connection and synchronizes initial sequence numbers. ACK (Acknowledgment) confirms received information. RST (Reset) resets a connection or connection attempt.
1. The scanner sends SYN: “I want to connect; here is my synchronization information.”
2. The target returns SYN+ACK: “I received your request; here is my synchronization information.”
3. The scanner returns ACK: “Received.” The ordinary handshake completes, allowing data exchange.

TCP Connect Scan calls the operating system's connect(). The TCP/IP stack handles the handshake and Nmap reads success or an error. The scan normally ends the test connection shortly afterward; connection establishment does not mean an HTTP request was sent.

rows: TCP establishment is possible from here
Explicit refusal, typically a target RST
Depends on the error; possibly filtered
Establishment failed; not every error means filtered

sourceBody.text: This method normally needs no special raw-packet privileges. A completed connection can leave connection or immediate-disconnection records on the service, and many connections can add load. [Nmap TCP Connect](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-connect-scan.html)

visual.caption: TCP Connect: complete the handshake
visual.description: Use connect() to establish TCP, then end the test.

items.title: SYN
items.body: Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.

items.title: SYN+ACK
items.body: Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization information.

items.title: ACK
items.body: Scanner → target: complete the ordinary handshake.

items.title: Interpretation
items.body: TCP success still requires separate TLS, HTTP and application checks.

sourceBody.text: 4 | SYN scanning: interpret the opening exchange

SYN Scan sends SYN first. A target SYN+ACK already indicates willingness to accept establishment. The scanner side resets the attempt with RST instead of sending the final ACK of an ordinary handshake. Half-open Scan describes this incomplete handshake, not a port being halfway open.

Scanner → target: SYN
Target → scanner: SYN+ACK
Scanner → target: RST
Interpretation: open; no ordinary three-way handshake completed

rows: The target accepts the opening request
No response after retries, or certain ICMP unreachable errors
This method cannot establish open versus closed

sourceBody.text: Read the direction of RST. A target RST refuses the connection; a scanner-side RST following SYN+ACK ends a probe that already obtained evidence. The scanner's operating system may generate that reset. Actual RST/ACK combinations depend on implementation.

Silence can reflect blocked outbound or return traffic, packet loss or equipment problems. filtered alone does not prove a firewall exists. IPv4 SYN scanning also classifies ICMP Type 3, Code 1/2/3/9/10/13 as filtered. [Nmap SYN](https://nmap.org/book/synscan.html)
sudo nmap -sS -p 443 192.0.2.20

-sS normally needs raw-packet privileges; requirements depend on the operating system, capabilities and packet driver. Nmap still uses operating-system interfaces to send and receive probes, rather than delegating the complete handshake to connect() as -sT does.

Stealth Scan is a historical name. Applications that log only completed connections may record less, but firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS) and intrusion prevention systems (IPS) can still observe SYN and reset patterns across ports. SYN scans are detectable.

visual.caption: SYN Scan: reset after the opening response
visual.description: SYN+ACK supplies open evidence; no final ACK is sent.

items.title: SYN
items.body: Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.

items.title: SYN+ACK
items.body: Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization information.

items.title: RST
items.body: Scanner → target: reset; the ordinary handshake is incomplete.

items.title: Interpretation
items.body: A target RST refuses; a scanner-side RST ends this attempt.

sourceBody.text: 5 | UDP scanning: use datagrams and error reports

UDP sends datagrams directly, without a TCP handshake. Like sending a letter, receiving no reply leaves several possibilities: no reply was needed, the recipient could not understand the content, the request was lost or filtered, or the reply was lost.

Payload means the content carried in a datagram. DNS may answer a valid query while ignoring empty or invalid content; DNS, NTP and SNMP each define their own formats. Nmap uses protocol-specific payloads for some common UDP ports; other probes may not be meaningful requests for the service.

rows: Policy or the path prevents confirmation
Cannot distinguish an open silent endpoint from filtering

sourceBody.text: ICMP communicates IP errors and status. UDP has no TCP RST; a host receiving a datagram for an endpoint without a receiver may typically return ICMP Port Unreachable. Check the error's source and the original datagram quoted inside it. Do not transfer IPv4 type/code numbers directly to ICMPv6.

The “|” in open|filtered means “or”: two possibilities remain. It establishes neither definite openness nor a stopped service. Suitable -sV service probes may elicit a response and narrow the state to open. Otherwise, configuration or logs can add evidence. A UDP reply establishes only that exchange, not every application function. [Nmap UDP](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-udp-scan.html)

visual.caption: UDP: send a datagram, interpret four outcomes
visual.description: Scanner → target: UDP datagram. Cards are alternative outcomes, not a sequence.

items.title: open
items.body: A corresponding UDP reply: an endpoint responded on this path.

items.title: closed
items.body: IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 3: Port Unreachable.

items.title: filtered
items.body: IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 1, 2, 9, 10 or 13.

items.title: open|filtered
items.body: No reply after retries: possibly open and silent, or filtered.

items.title: Interpretation
items.body: Match ICMP to its source and original datagram; IPv4 codes do not apply to ICMPv6.

sourceBody.text: 6 | Why waiting time, rate and position matter

A timeout means no expected reply arrived within the configured interval; a retry sends another probe. If a scanner waits 100 ms but the response arrives after 300 ms, it may time out too early. More retries cost time, packets and equipment load, so choose them for the environment.

Testing 1,000 ports at 10 versus 1,000 ports per second changes the rate. Excessive rates may trigger limiting or packet loss, producing more timeouts; these numbers are examples. UDP also encounters ICMP rate limiting: even when several ports lack listeners, a host may not immediately report an error for every probe. This can make UDP scans slow.
sudo nmap -sU -p 53,123,161 --max-rate 10 192.0.2.20

--max-rate 10 caps Nmap's probe transmission rate at 10 packets per second. It is not universally optimal. Start with a few approved ports and adjust for device capacity, maintenance windows and stop conditions.

The same server's TCP 22 may appear open from the laboratory and filtered externally. Both observations can hold because sources, routes and firewall policies differ. First verify that NAT, proxies or load balancers did not direct the tests to different endpoints.

Network Address Translation (NAT) may forward a public endpoint to a private address such as 192.168.1.100. External clients usually contact the public address; without matching port forwarding, probes may not reach the internal host. Different internal and external results need not mean the service changed, and not all NAT outcomes are necessarily filtered.
When comparing reports, retain the source IP, destination endpoint, time, TCP/UDP, port, method, payload, timeout/retries, rate, tool version and path policies.

sourceBody.text: 7 | Compare the three methods

The same silence produces different SYN and UDP classifications because a working UDP service can receive data without replying. Include method and observation in a conclusion: “At this time, from this source, TCP 443 returned SYN+ACK to SYN, so the SYN scan records open; website functionality needs a separate check.”
8 | Observe TCP and UDP on your own Ubuntu machine

Environment: Ubuntu, Python 3 and Nmap; packet capture additionally needs tcpdump and suitable privileges. Use only 127.0.0.1. Check TCP 8000, TCP 8001 and UDP 9999 for existing use. If occupied, stop and choose consistent alternate test ports instead of closing another service. Expected results below are examples; local policy affects actual behavior.

ss -ltnu
# If tools are missing, decide whether to install them on the lab machine:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install nmap tcpdump
8.1 | TCP: the same open state, different handshakes
In Terminal A, serve an empty lab directory to avoid sharing private files:

mkdir -p /tmp/ceh-m0303-http
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /tmp/ceh-m0303-http
In Terminal B, run both scans, assuming TCP 8001 has no listener:
Both may report 8000/tcp open and 8001/tcp closed. SERVICE names depend on Nmap's database; focus on states and packet flow. Start capture in Terminal C, then repeat the scans:
sudo tcpdump -i lo -nn 'tcp port 8000 or tcp port 8001'

Observe who sends SYN, who returns SYN+ACK, the final Connect ACK and the SYN scan reset. RST/ACK combinations and teardown details depend on the OS and Nmap implementation. Stop the HTTP server and tcpdump with Ctrl+C. Remove the empty directory with rmdir /tmp/ceh-m0303-http.
8.2 | UDP: listening without replying
Save this as udp_server.py and run python3 udp_server.py in Terminal A:

import socket

with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
    sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 9999))
    print("UDP 9999 listening; no replies")
    while True:
        data, addr = sock.recvfrom(4096)
        print(f"Received {len(data)} bytes from {addr}")
        # Add the reply here in the second run.
Scan this endpoint in Terminal B:
sudo nmap -sU -p 9999 127.0.0.1

If the program receives data without replying, the result may be 9999/udp open|filtered. Nmap has only a waiting result. You separately have local evidence that a program is listening and receiving datagrams.
Stop the server with Ctrl+C. Add the following line after print inside the while loop, preserving the indentation, then restart:
sock.sendto(b"OK", addr)

Repeat the same scan. If Nmap receives the corresponding UDP reply, expect open. The listener is the same, but its reply behavior changes the scan evidence. Stop the server with Ctrl+C, confirm the process has ended, then remove the udp_server.py you created. If results differ, keep program output and check local firewall rules and privileges rather than treating an example as a guarantee.
9 | Security practice and three scenarios

An authorized laboratory inventory might include NAS TCP 5001/22/445, web TCP 443/80, and DNS UDP 53 plus TCP 53. Establish each endpoint's purpose and intended exposure, then compare internal/external observations, listener settings, firewall policies and logs. An open port can meet a business need and does not establish a vulnerability.

M03 scanning locates endpoints; M04 enumeration adds service information; M05 vulnerability analysis evaluates configurations and known issues; M12 protection concepts help verify detection and blocking. Compare IDS alerts with actual packets during the approved test window and retain retest results.
Question one: A SYN scan shows scanner SYN, target SYN+ACK, then scanner RST. What is the port state? Who sent the final RST? Did the three-way handshake complete?
Question two: UDP 53 is open|filtered. Can you conclude DNS is stopped? Give three possible causes and identify the evidence needed next.

Question three: NAS TCP 22 is open internally and filtered externally. Are those observations contradictory? Which equipment or policies can explain them? What else should you check to establish that SSH is not externally exposed?
10 | Tie conclusions to evidence
TCP Connect uses OS connection results; SYN uses opening responses; UDP combines datagram replies, ICMP and waiting results. Preserve uncertainty when nothing responds, especially for open|filtered.
Keep where, when, which method and which response with every result. M03-04 next examines Open, Closed, Filtered and observation position.

[Nmap scan techniques](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-techniques.html) · [TCP RFC 9293](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9293) · [UDP RFC 768](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc768) · [ICMP RFC 792](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc792)

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: SYN flow and RST direction
paragraphs: Classify it as open because the target returned SYN+ACK. The final RST comes from the scanner side and ends the attempt; the final ACK of an ordinary three-way handshake was not sent. The scanner's OS may generate this RST, so the flag alone does not establish target refusal.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: Possible causes of UDP silence
paragraphs: You cannot conclude DNS is stopped. The service may ignore an invalid payload, a firewall may drop the request, or a reply may be lost on its return path; ICMP error rate limiting can also increase waiting results. Retain open|filtered and add an authorized valid DNS query, a corresponding UDP reply, packet capture, and listener settings or service logs. Service detection may narrow uncertainty, but further silence still does not establish closure.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: Internal/external observations and SSH exposure
paragraphs: Both results can hold. Source policies, routing, NAT/port forwarding, proxies or load balancers can change the path and response. Confirm both tests address the same endpoint, record source, time, protocol, port and method, then check public addresses and IPv4/IPv6 endpoints, forwarding rules, firewalls and SSH bind addresses. Retest from approved external positions and compare logs. A single filtered result supports only that source and time; it does not establish closure across all external paths.

Add application-service evidence. For HTTPS, check the TLS channel and certificate result, then the HTTP response and expected page content. Include login or authorization checks when the task requires and authorizes them. Record time, method, and result at each layer.
